name: Color-Corrected Error Metrics
definition: An evaluation procedure to mitigate photometric variation (autoexposure/white balance shifts, clipped RGB) in 'in the wild' datasets like Tanks and Temples.
summary: Color-Corrected Error Metrics evaluate view synthesis by fitting a per-image polynomial to align rendered and ground truth images, mitigating photometric variations like autoexposure shifts that standard metrics penalize.
